Category.assoc]`. These are local, targeted, and follow `fin_cases`. I looked at the candidate lemmas and found no solid case for a simp change. The rubric says not to recommend simp attributes just because an identity looks simple. I did not check whether other files use these lemmas, and I did not check whether the imported definitions already carry simp lemmas that could overlap. I cannot run Lean, so I make no claim about simp behaviour. The very long `attribute [-simp]` and `attribute [-instance]` lines come from the project's environment setup and are not evidence about this file's own simp interface.
